decode_definition: (N-1) / (tN - t1), timestamps in seconds; first N=min(64, non-EOG output count) events; 63 intervals ending at tokens 2..64 for N=64
controller_time_definition: rank0-to-rank1: confirmed half completion to peer start at the same position; rank1-to-rank0: target half completion to next half using its verified token; signed overlap retained separately from nonnegative handover cost

rank_metrics.gpu_idle_estimate_kind: lower bound from host command occupancy
rank_metrics.gpu_idle_estimate_scope: request wall minus union of full rank command envelopes; command time may contain GPU idle, so this is a lower bound, not measured GPU event time

rank_metrics.gpu_idle_estimate_kind: lower bound from host command occupancy
rank_metrics.gpu_idle_estimate_scope: request wall minus union of full rank command envelopes; command time may contain GPU idle, so this is a lower bound, not measured GPU event time

ttft_definition: 1000 * (t1 - request_start); prompt processing plus first generated token
prompt_wall_definition: native/controller prompt_wall_ms includes first generated token; do not add it to TTFT
wall_rate_definition: output_tokens / (request_end - request_start); prompt plus full generation, excludes load/reset/teardown
submission_definition: rate for the 99 inter-token intervals between generated-token timestamps 1 and 100 after TTFT; 99 / (t100 - t1), timestamps in seconds; 100 events, 99 intervals
rank_timing_scope: model request only, excluding load/teardown; busy includes half and draft wall time, idle includes coordinator and accept/rollback IO
decode_rank_timing_scope: native host HALF/DRAFT wall occupancy clipped to non-EOG decode span; includes uploads/drains, not GPU busy time
